def pin(name):

  with (ROOT/name).open('rb') as stream:
   for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(65536),b''):h.update(block);size+=len(block)

def branch(function,case):

 for node in ast.walk(function):
  if isinstance(node,ast.If) and isinstance(node.test,ast.Compare):
   t=node.test
   if isinstance(t.left,ast.Name) and t.left.id=='identifier' and len(t.ops)==1 and isinstance(t.ops[0],ast.Eq) and len(t.comparators)==1 and isinstance(t.comparators[0],ast.Constant) and t.comparators[0].value==case:matches.append([dump(n) for n in node.body])
 assert len(matches)==1
 return matches[0]
